journey.name: Wear - State Retention Across Screen Off
journey.description:
Verifies that the watch app is exactly where the user left it after the screen turns off and on, after leaving to the watch face and coming back, and after the system kills the app's process in the background: same screen, same scroll position, same typed text.
The last steps open the app from the launcher widget and then from the launcher, which must come back to the same screen too, not start a second copy of the app on top.
Run on a round Wear OS emulator with the bench build. Start with the app stopped and the Nubecita widget added to the watch. docs/wear-testing.md has the commands for screen off and on, the watch face, opening from the launcher, killing the background process and showing the widget. Type by tapping the on-screen keys.

actions.action: Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "default"
Tap Home
Scroll down with the rotary crown until the post by Cleo Marsh that begins "The lake was perfectly still" is in the middle of the screen
Turn the screen off, wait 5 seconds, and turn the screen on
Verify that the feed is shown with the post by Cleo Marsh still in the middle of the screen
Tap the post by Cleo Marsh and scroll down to the Like, Repost and Bookmark controls
Tap Bookmark
Verify that Bookmark is off
Turn the screen off, wait 5 seconds, and turn the screen on
Verify that the post by Cleo Marsh is shown, scrolled to its controls, with Bookmark off
Go to the watch face, then open Nubecita again from the launcher
Verify that the post by Cleo Marsh is shown, not the landing screen
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the feed is shown with the post by Cleo Marsh in the middle of the screen
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Tap Messages and tap the conversation "Weekend Trip"
Verify that the thread is shown with its newest message, "I'll bring snacks."
Turn the screen off, wait 5 seconds, and turn the screen on
Verify that the thread is still shown with its newest message, "I'll bring snacks."
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen twice to return to the landing screen
Tap New post, tap the keyboard choice, type "keep me" by tapping the on-screen keys, and tap the keyboard's Send key
Verify that the review screen shows the text "Keep me"
Turn the screen off, wait 5 seconds, and turn the screen on
Verify that the review screen still shows the text "Keep me" with the buttons Change and Post
Go to the watch face, kill the app's background process, then open Nubecita again from the launcher
Verify that the review screen still shows the text "Keep me"
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the landing screen is shown
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to close the app, then show the Nubecita widget
Tap Home on the widget and then tap the first post, by Ana Ruiz
Verify that the post by Ana Ruiz is shown on its own screen
Go to the watch face, then open Nubecita again from the launcher
Verify that the post by Ana Ruiz is shown, not the landing screen
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the feed "Following" is shown
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen twice
Verify that Nubecita is no longer on screen
